WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0

    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (

                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id

                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (

        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (

    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (

                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )

WITH agg AS (

                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id

    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )

WITH agg AS (
                SELECT
                    cs.channel_id,
                    bool_or(s.is_catchup AND a.is_active)  AS any_catchup,
                    MAX(s.catchup_days) FILTER (WHERE s.is_catchup AND a.is_active) AS max_days
                FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                WHERE cs.channel_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
                GROUP BY cs.channel_id
            )
            UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET
                is_catchup   = COALESCE(agg.any_catchup, FALSE),
                catchup_days = COALESCE(agg.max_days, 0)
            FROM agg
            WHERE c.id = agg.channel_id

UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c
            SET is_catchup = FALSE, catchup_days = 0
            WHERE c.is_catchup = TRUE
              AND c.id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.channel_id
        FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
        JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
        WHERE s.m3u_account_id = %s
    )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs
                  JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id = cs.stream_id
                  JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id = s.m3u_account_id
                  WHERE cs.channel_id = c.id
                    AND s.is_catchup = TRUE
                    AND a.is_active = TRUE
              )
